grader.scenario: Direct debit payment date adjustment from 12th to 28th following new employer payday
grader.notes: Exemplary billing resolution demonstrating late empathy (3 turns after initial concern), payment deferral to protect customer from overdraft charges, and seamless mandate reconfiguration.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net billing customer services' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hold was announced with bear with me and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Harper warmly throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Agent delivered late empathy at [02:25] after ledger review ('I completely appreciate how stressful that timing gap is when starting a new job, Harper, and how vital it is to align your direct debit with your new payday...').

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent restated the payday transition and direct debit shift accurately at [01:15].

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent confirmed landline number accurately without repeating questions.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent updated mandate to 28th, deferred current invoice, suppressed reminders, and confirmed reference DDA-44019-J.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent maintained an exemplary, supportive, and congratulatory tone throughout.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent asked relevant questions regarding current collection dates and bank arrangements.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Customer confirmed new 28th direct debit schedule agreed and noted reference code.
